title_suffix: Classic change flow and Claude hook enforcement
summary: This patch release restores the fast OSpec 1.0-style change workflow as the default small-change path, moves the full 1.2 workflow behind ospec goal, and adds Claude Code hook enforcement for announce, brainstorm, and required-decision gates.
new: Added the packaged ospec-goal skill for the full document, task graph, worker, review, and evidence workflow.
Added the Claude Code hook bundle installed by ospec session hook --target claude --apply, including SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Task, and Bash hook handling.
improved: Restored ospec-change and ospec new to the classic fast workflow for small routine changes while keeping complex work on ospec-goal.
Improved Announce-Before-Act, Brainstorm-First, and Zero-Setup guidance across packaged skills, AI guidance, and project conventions.
Improved Claude Code release packaging by deriving Claude skill installs from the Codex packaged source instead of maintaining stale duplicate skill files.
fixed: Fixed Claude hook installation so malformed .claude/settings.json files are never overwritten during --apply.
Fixed Claude hook Bash handling so chained, piped, redirected, or shell-expanding commands that merely start with ospec are not auto-allowed.
Fixed session hook target parsing so unsupported --target values fail explicitly instead of being silently ignored.
docs: Documented ospec session hook --target claude --apply and clarified the split between classic changes and full goals.
Added release metadata for 1.2.2 so GitHub Release notes and local release-note preview use curated structured content.
